model.name: Claude Opus 5.5 3D
model.shortDescription: Build 3D objects from text or up to 8 images, or edit an existing model with visual guidance. Choose effort, topology and export format, with a Blender file included.

inputs.description: Building: 1 to 8 photos of the object, or leave empty to build from the prompt alone. Editing: optional images that guide the change, like a material sample, a logo or a marked-up view of the model.
inputs.label: Reference Images
inputs.name: images

inputs.description: Optional. Add any 3D model to edit it instead of building a new one. It comes back in the same format.
inputs.label: Edit a 3D Model
inputs.name: sceneFile

inputs.description: Building: describe the object, like "a weathered tugboat with a red hull", or just name it when you add photos. Editing: describe the change, like "open the lid".
inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.name: prompt

sceneFile.message: Describe the change to make to the 3D model.

images.message: Describe the object to build, or add reference images or a 3D model to edit.

inputs.description: Standard for simple objects or small edits like a recolor. High or Maximum for detailed objects, or edits that add or reshape parts. When editing, match it to the change, not the model.
inputs.label: Effort
inputs.name: buildEffort

inputs.description: Max triangles for a new model: 10k–50k for games, 250k for fine detail. Not used when editing.
inputs.label: Polycount Limit
inputs.name: faceBudget

inputs.description: Format of the delivered model, which always comes with its Blender file. Auto: a GLB when building, the edited model's own format when editing. With Quads, an FBX unless the model is already FBX, OBJ, PLY or USDZ.
inputs.label: Output Format
inputs.name: outputFormat

inputs.description: Faces of the delivered model, checked before it is returned. Auto keeps an edited model's faces and lets the model choose for a new one.
inputs.label: Topology
inputs.name: topology
